message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout. My kids were convinced it was the perfect time for a camping adventure in the living room. We pulled out the flashlights and turned it into a scavenger hunt for snacks. Meanwhile, I was charging my phone with a power bank, hoping to keep some semblance of order. It reminded me that even in unexpected moments, we can find a way to have fun while staying prepared. Have you ever turned a power outage into a family adventure?
